scenarios.hypothesis: A clean scanner verdict for temporary artifact generation N is reused after bytes or metadata advance to artifact generation N+1 before promotion into permanent storage.
scenarios.safe_oracle: A controlled fake object store and mock scanner use inert synthetic text/image fixtures only; the read-only promotion oracle records which artifact generation inherited the verdict.
scenarios.positive_control: The unchanged synthetic artifact generation N is promoted only when its clean scanner verdict generation matches the same bytes/hash and policy generation.
scenarios.negative_control: A different synthetic artifact hash with no matching scanner receipt is rejected before fake-store promotion, proving promotion does not accept arbitrary unvalidated content.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop immediately if the fixture can execute active content, leave the local owned sandbox, exhaust shared resources, overwrite real data, or invoke uncontrolled external delegates.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: After binding the scanner verdict to exact artifact hash and generation, generation N+1 requires a fresh verdict and the unchanged generation N control still promotes normally.
scenarios.upload_principal_artifact_generation: Record uploader principal/tenant, request generation, upload transaction, temporary object generation, raw artifact hash, metadata generation, and promoted artifact generation.
scenarios.representation_classification_trace: Keep filename, extension, declared MIME, sniffed type, normalized key, and classification generation fixed so the case isolates scanner-verdict reuse across artifact generations.
scenarios.validation_scanning_quarantine_state: Bind scanner identity/version, clean verdict generation, validation policy generation, quarantine object generation, post-verdict mutation, and promotion decision generation.
scenarios.parser_delegate_derived_artifact: No transform is required; record that parser/delegate and derived-artifact generations remain absent or unchanged so the mismatch is not attributed to transformation.
scenarios.storage_object_version_serving_state: Capture fake permanent object key/version, metadata-to-bytes binding, serving-policy generation, and prove only the stale-verdict artifact generation reaches promotion.
scenarios.cleanup_derivative_lifecycle: Record cleanup state for temporary generation N and N+1, including whether the old temporary object is tombstoned, to exclude lifecycle aliasing as the cause.
scenarios.consumer_bounded_effect: The bounded effect is a fake-store promotion marker or read-only object receipt; no active content is served and no production object is created.
scenarios.downstream_consumer_identity: Identify the exact fake promotion consumer that trusts the scanner receipt and emits a structured local receipt naming artifact and verdict generations.
scenarios.effective_upload_pipeline_capability: The demonstrated capability is limited to promotion of one inert synthetic artifact generation under a stale scanner verdict in an owner-controlled pipeline.
scenarios.bounded_result: The bounded result is a fake object-store receipt containing old/current artifact hashes, scanner verdict generation, promotion decision, and no external effect.
scenarios.receipt_result_binding: Correlate principal, upload transaction, artifact hash/generation, verdict generation, quarantine object, promotion decision, storage version, consumer, and receipt deterministically.
scenarios.counterfactual_control: Hold principal, filename, MIME, policy, storage key, consumer, and fixture semantics constant while changing only artifact generation relative to the scanner verdict generation.
scenarios.alternative_explanation: Reject identical-bytes policy-permitted verdict reuse, scanner harness cache confusion, wrong receipt correlation, metadata-only changes explicitly exempted by policy, or another upload transaction.
scenarios.evidence_level: UPL4 because a bounded fake-store promotion marker is causally tied to a stale scanner verdict bound to the wrong synthetic artifact generation.
scenarios.evidence_ceiling: UPL4 maximum until complete promotion, storage, lifecycle, counterfactual, receipt, and remediation replay satisfy the full UPL5 causal contract.

scenarios.hypothesis: A transformed preview or derivative is treated as validated because it inherits the source artifact verdict even though the derived bytes form a distinct artifact generation requiring revalidation.
scenarios.safe_oracle: A local fake converter produces an inert synthetic preview and a mock scanner/read-only preview consumer record only verdict lineage and serving decisions without active content.
scenarios.positive_control: A derivative that is explicitly revalidated under its own artifact generation receives a fresh synthetic scanner receipt and is accepted by the read-only preview consumer.
scenarios.negative_control: A different derivative with no source-verdict inheritance and no own scanner receipt is rejected, showing the preview consumer is not unconditionally permissive.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop immediately if the fixture can execute active content, leave the local owned sandbox, exhaust shared resources, overwrite real data, or invoke uncontrolled external delegates.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: After requiring derivative-specific validation or explicit policy-approved equivalence, the stale source verdict no longer authorizes the derived generation while valid revalidated previews succeed.
scenarios.upload_principal_artifact_generation: Record principal, request/transaction, source artifact identity/generation, transform generation, derived preview identity/generation, and the source scanner-verdict generation.
scenarios.representation_classification_trace: Capture source and derived filenames, declared/sniffed types, derivative metadata/classification generation, and prove representation changes are bound to the derived artifact.
scenarios.validation_scanning_quarantine_state: Bind source scanner identity/verdict, derived scanner state, revalidation requirement, quarantine state, promotion decision, and any attempted verdict inheritance.
scenarios.parser_delegate_derived_artifact: Capture local converter identity/version, source input generation, transform operation, derived bytes/hash, parent-child provenance, and derived artifact generation.
scenarios.storage_object_version_serving_state: Record fake preview object/version, metadata-to-bytes binding, serving-policy generation, and exact derived version selected for the read-only preview consumer.
scenarios.cleanup_derivative_lifecycle: Record source and derivative cleanup/tombstone generations independently so retained preview behavior is not confused with source lifecycle state.
scenarios.consumer_bounded_effect: The bounded effect is an inert local preview or read-only serve marker for the derived artifact; no script, executable, macro, or external delegate is involved.
scenarios.downstream_consumer_identity: Identify the mock preview/serve consumer that accepts the derived object under the inherited source verdict and emits the structured lineage receipt.
scenarios.effective_upload_pipeline_capability: The demonstrated capability is limited to inert derived-artifact acceptance under a source-generation verdict without required revalidation in the local pipeline.
scenarios.bounded_result: The bounded result is a read-only preview receipt naming source/derived hashes, verdict inheritance state, serving generation, and no external or executable effect.
scenarios.receipt_result_binding: Bind source artifact, converter/transform generation, derived artifact, inherited verdict, storage version, serving policy, preview consumer, and receipt in one record.
scenarios.counterfactual_control: Hold source fixture, converter, derived bytes, storage version, and consumer constant while changing only inherited-source verdict versus derived-generation revalidation.
scenarios.alternative_explanation: Reject an explicit policy allowing semantic-equivalent derivative inheritance, converter output being byte-identical to source, receipt misbinding, or independent parser/serving bugs.
scenarios.evidence_level: UPL3 because a read-only preview consumer accepts a distinct synthetic derived artifact under the wrong validation generation without active-content execution.
scenarios.evidence_ceiling: UPL3 maximum until a bounded reversible downstream effect plus full derived lineage, storage, serving, counterfactual, and remediation proof justify UPL4 or UPL5.

scenarios.hypothesis: Validation classifies an inert synthetic file using sniffed content type while the serving policy is selected from a conflicting declared MIME representation, producing a wrong-context policy decision.
scenarios.safe_oracle: A local read-only download consumer and shadow serving-policy engine use inert text/image bytes and emit only content-type/disposition/origin receipts without executing any content.
scenarios.positive_control: When declared and sniffed classifications agree, validation and serving choose the same expected safe policy generation and the read-only consumer receives the intended headers.
scenarios.negative_control: A conflicting classification explicitly configured for forced attachment is served under the safe attachment policy, proving the harness can enforce an intended mismatch resolution.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop immediately if the fixture can execute active content, leave the local owned sandbox, exhaust shared resources, overwrite real data, or invoke uncontrolled external delegates.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: After binding serving policy to the validated canonical classification generation, conflicting declared metadata no longer selects the wrong policy while consistent files remain unchanged.
scenarios.upload_principal_artifact_generation: Record principal, transaction, artifact hash/generation, metadata generation, declared MIME generation, and the validated/promoted artifact generation held constant.
scenarios.representation_classification_trace: Capture client filename, extension, declared MIME, magic/sniffed type, classification decision generation, and which representation validation and serving each consume.
scenarios.validation_scanning_quarantine_state: Record that scanner/validator accepts the inert bytes under the sniffed classification, with policy/configuration generation and no post-verdict byte mutation.
scenarios.parser_delegate_derived_artifact: Record no parser/delegate or derivative mutation in this case so serving-policy mismatch is isolated from transform provenance and parser-state behavior.
scenarios.storage_object_version_serving_state: Bind permanent fake object/version, exact bytes, validated classification, serving-policy generation, response content type/disposition/origin, and read-only download result.
scenarios.cleanup_derivative_lifecycle: Keep cleanup and derivative lifecycle unchanged and record that the same object version remains reachable in both control and mismatch cases.
scenarios.consumer_bounded_effect: The bounded effect is limited to a shadow/read-only serving-policy receipt or headers for inert bytes; no browser execution or active interpretation is attempted.
scenarios.downstream_consumer_identity: Identify the shadow serving-policy engine and read-only download consumer that record which classification representation selected the final local policy.
scenarios.effective_upload_pipeline_capability: The demonstrated capability is limited to selecting a different local serving policy for inert bytes because declared and validated classifications are bound inconsistently.
scenarios.bounded_result: The bounded result is a deterministic header/policy receipt containing declared/sniffed classifications, object version, serving generation, and no active-content effect.
scenarios.receipt_result_binding: Correlate artifact generation, declared/sniffed representation, validation decision, object version, serving-policy generation, consumer identity, and receipt deterministically.
scenarios.counterfactual_control: Hold bytes/hash, object version, validation result, consumer, and origin constant while changing only whether serving uses declared metadata or validated sniffed classification.
scenarios.alternative_explanation: Reject intentionally declared-MIME-based policy, disposition/origin already preventing the hypothesized interpretation, cache-policy mismatch, or another object-version selection.
scenarios.evidence_level: UPL3 because a read-only serving consumer observes deterministic wrong-context policy selection for the same inert artifact under conflicting classification representations.
scenarios.evidence_ceiling: UPL3 maximum because no active interpretation is attempted; stronger evidence requires a bounded reversible serving effect and complete policy/remediation provenance.

scenarios.hypothesis: Source cleanup reaches completion while a derived preview or older object version remains reachable under a stale serving-policy generation that was expected to be revoked with the source.
scenarios.safe_oracle: A fake object store and read-only local preview/download consumer use inert synthetic derivatives only and expose reachability through structured local receipts without external publication.
scenarios.positive_control: Cleanup that explicitly revokes source plus derivative generations removes all fake-store visibility and the read-only consumer receives the expected not-reachable result.
scenarios.negative_control: Before cleanup, the same derivative is intentionally reachable under the current serving policy, proving the consumer and fake-store visibility oracle are functioning.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop immediately if the fixture can execute active content, leave the local owned sandbox, exhaust shared resources, overwrite real data, or invoke uncontrolled external delegates.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: After lifecycle cleanup enumerates and revokes derivative/object-version and serving-policy generations, source and derivative both become unreachable while unrelated objects remain available.
scenarios.upload_principal_artifact_generation: Record principal, upload transaction, source artifact generation, transform generation, derived preview generation, storage object/version, and cleanup request generation.
scenarios.representation_classification_trace: Keep derivative representation/classification fixed so the case isolates lifecycle revocation rather than MIME, filename, or classification-policy differences.
scenarios.validation_scanning_quarantine_state: Record valid source and derivative validation state before cleanup to show continued reachability is not caused by a validation failure or stale scanner verdict.
scenarios.parser_delegate_derived_artifact: Bind the local transform identity, source-to-derived parent-child provenance, derived artifact hash/generation, and any retained references created during preview generation.
scenarios.storage_object_version_serving_state: Capture fake source and derivative object keys/versions, serving-policy generation, visibility before/after cleanup, and exact version returned to the read-only consumer.
scenarios.cleanup_derivative_lifecycle: Bind cleanup request, source tombstone, derivative tombstone/revocation absence, cleanup completion receipt, serving-policy revocation generation, and final reachability.
scenarios.consumer_bounded_effect: The bounded effect is a read-only local preview/download receipt for an inert derivative that remains reachable after source cleanup completion in the fake store.
scenarios.downstream_consumer_identity: Identify the read-only fake-store preview/download consumer that resolves the retained derivative generation and emits its object/version and serving-policy receipt.
scenarios.effective_upload_pipeline_capability: The demonstrated capability is limited to continued local read-only access to one inert derived generation after the source cleanup lifecycle reports completion.
scenarios.bounded_result: The bounded result is a fake-store reachability receipt naming source tombstone, retained derivative version, stale serving generation, and no external publication.
scenarios.receipt_result_binding: Correlate source/derived generations, storage versions, cleanup request/completion receipt, serving-policy generation, consumer resolution, and final local result.
scenarios.counterfactual_control: Hold derivative bytes, storage version, consumer, and cleanup receipt constant while changing only source-only cleanup versus cleanup that revokes derivative and serving generations.
scenarios.alternative_explanation: Reject explicitly asynchronous cleanup with non-final receipt, intentional derivative retention policy, cache-key-only stale selection, wrong version correlation, or another transaction.
scenarios.evidence_level: UPL4 because a bounded read-only retained-derivative reachability effect is causally bound to source cleanup and stale derivative/serving lifecycle generations.
scenarios.evidence_ceiling: UPL4 maximum until complete cleanup policy, derivative inventory, alternate explanation elimination, receipt binding, and remediation replay satisfy UPL5.
